NYSE Arca has filed with the SEC to list Grayscale’s spot Dogecoin ETF, initiating a regulatory review that may take up to 90 days. The move aligns with Grayscale’s efforts to expand its crypto ETF offerings.

The number of Dogecoin wallets holding over 1 million DOGE has risen, indicating increased accumulation by large holders during the broader market pullback, according to a report.
